TRIAL.pages.NINJA.description: A [green]smug-looking, panini-eating man[/green] is accused of [red]aggravated assault[/red], [red]attempted murder[/red] and [purple]unlawful possession of confidential information[/purple]. The accusations are so easily refuted that the procuror seems to be [sine]phasing in and out of existence[/sine].
TRIAL.pages.NINJA.options.INNOCENT.title: DECIDE: Innocent
TRIAL.pages.NINJA.options.INNOCENT.descr: [red]Add Doubt to your Deck.[/red] [green]Upgrade a card in your Deck.[/green]
TRIAL.pages.NINJA.options.GUILTY.title: DECIDE: Guilty
TRIAL.pages.NINJA_INNOCENT.description: It looks like he was just trying to send food to a comrade in a lazy way. No need to make such a fuss about it… [sine]Right?…[/sine]
TRIAL.pages.NINJA_GUILTY.description: The defendant is obviously a [gold]panininja[/gold], using paninis as thrown weapons. The defense attorney beats you up to show you what [red]real pain[/red] is.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_SOUL.title: Monster Soul
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_SOUL.pages.INITI:
You find a [blue]blue crystal[/blue] upon your path.

It is clearly a magic item of some sort, and seems charged with some kind of wild energy. You could hold on to it... but you don't recognise the magic it holds, and it could be [red]very dangerous[/red].
[green]Heal to full HP.[/green] Add [red]Regret[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_SOUL.pages.HOLD_:
You hesitantly grab the crystal and focus on it. Your mind gets overwhelmed by [sine]memories[/sine]...

You remember, now. They were [red]yours[/red] to begin with.

You hesitantly grab the crystal and focus on it. Your mind gets overwhelmed by [sine]memories[/sine]...

You remember, now. You were with [purple]her[/purple] when it happened.

You hesitantly grab the crystal and focus on it. Your mind gets overwhelmed by [sine]memories[/sine]...

Dazed, you try and make sense of your newfound knowledge; a profound, beast-like [red]instinct[/red] now living within you.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_SOUL.pages.SMASH:
Can't trust a magic thingamajig you don't know. You grab the crystal and crush it in your palm.

Somehow, you feel like you lost something [red]precious[/red]. Your heart [red]hurts[/red] as you quickly walk away.

Can't trust a magic thingamajig you don't know. You grab the crystal and crush it in your palm.

You hear a painful [red]screech[/red] inside your head. Was that... [purple]Shion?[/purple] But how?

Can't trust a magic thingamajig you don't know. You grab the crystal and crush it in your palm.

You're overcome with a feeling of [red]deep regret[/red]. As if you accidentally hurt someone...
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BATTLE.title: Team Battle
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BATTLE.pages.INITIA: You can't believe your eyes. Another, [jitter]identical[/jitter] team of ascenders. Fakers? Clones? Illusions? They look just as surprised as you are.
Gain a [gold]Team Blast[/gold] card reward. Add [red]Clumsy[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Fight your counterpart one on one
Gain a [gold]Rare[/gold] card reward. Add [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Gain [blue]2[/blue] card rewards from your teammates' cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BATTLE.pages.AS_TEA: It is time to show off what you are made of! Through elaborate innovations, you best your opponent, proving that the original is always better than the copy. It could use some improvements, but you developed a cool new way to fight together.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BATTLE.pages.ONE_ON: You just heard that faker steal your catchphrase. The confrontation is strange. They might know everything you are going to do, but you know everything they are going to do. You do gain the upper hand in the end, but their dirty tricks were somewhat eye-opening about your own potential.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAM_BATTLE.pages.TEAMMA: You have traveled with your companion long enough to know exactly where his weaknesses lie. Lo and behold, these strangers do have similar ones. You manage to exploit them and win the fight rather easily, but not before learning a thing or two about your comrade.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.title: The Gambler
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.pages.INITIA:
A curiously ovoidal man with a spectacular moustache invites you under his tent. [red]“Care for a little game of chance? Great fortunes for the lucky, shame for the quitter…”[/red]

There is a table, a dice, and an obviously small chance to win.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.pages.ALL.op: Transform a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [red]{CurseName}[/red].
[red]Pay {Gold} Gold.[/red] The curse above is randomized.
You would play more, but you are out of [gold]Gold[/gold].
[red]Lose ALL of your Gold.[/red] Obtain the [gold]Cursed Dice[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.pages.PLAY_O:
You pay the price, you take the dice. It whispers to you. [purple][sine]“Great Fortunes… Great Fortunes…”[/sine][/purple] You are compelled to throw it on the table in a gesture that feels too perfect to be your own. It lands on a curse. Of course it does. And as it does, the man repeats, tirelessly…

{Result}

You pay the price, you take the dice. [purple][sine]“Great Fortunes… Great Fortunes…”[/sine][/purple] You throw the dice. It lands on a curse.

{Result}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.QUITTER: [red][sine]“Great fortunes for the lucky, {CurseName} for the quitter…”[/sine][/red]
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.pages.DO_NOT:
[red]“{CurseName} for the quitter it is, then…”[/red]

You leave, annoyed, and strangely unable to forget about this unpleasant experience.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.pages.CELEBR:
[red]“Lucky you… May Great Fortunes follow you on your way [sine]forever[/sine]!”[/red]

That man appears genuinely happy for you, but you are relieved to leave. Time to see if this was a good investment.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-THE_GAMBLER.pages.PLAY_U:
You did not win. But you gave everything you had. [red]“You are not a quitter. You are a true player. It was not for now, but you are destined to find great fortunes.”[/red]

The man lets you leave, and you are even allowed to keep the dice. Naturally, you pocket it and tread on with a smile on your face.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STRIFE_ARCHITECT_INTRO.l: Persistent, aren't we?
What a waste of time…
Back so soon?
Neow must be working overtime…
This persistent fool at the bottom layers must really want to kill me.
I can't say I care why, or how.
Unless….
Those gems. They do hold an interesting enough power.
Fine, then, {ClassName}.
Fine, then, “{ClassName}”. Or was it “{FirstName}”?
I'll give you a modicum of time.
Disappoint me, and I'll make sure the last of the Ironclads is given the unceremonious death he deserves.
Disappoint me, and I'll reduce your sisterhood to actual, forevermore silence.
Disappoint me, and I'll make you into a room of this very Spire, doomed to be raided by pitiful creatures, helpless.
Disappoint me, and I'll cut your head off in front of your entire planet.
Disappoint me, and… well, you have so little to lose at this point, anyway. I will find more to take, though.
Disappoint me, and nowhere in any universe will you feel safe ever again.
Disappoint me, and I'll scatter your atoms across the winds for your “lover” to find.
Disappoint me, and I'll replace your very blood with [purple]Blight[/purple].
Disappoint me, and I'll go entertain myself on that refuge of strays of yours.
Disappoint me, and you will soon find out there are fates worse than death.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STRIFE_ENDING.title: The Architect
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STRIFE_ENDING.lines.0: The fool implementing this mod hasn't gotten to this part, yet.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STRIFE_ENDING.lines.1: You will know your fate soon enough.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STRIFE_ENDING.lines.2: No congratulations from me, for now, I'm afraid.
